title: Vee Steward Run v1
description: What one run of the steward did: each problem it took on, whether its fix was kept, and the gate on the resulting head. A fix is kept only when a new review is complete, adds no blocking finding, breaks no verification that passed, and solves its problem.

base.description: The commit the change is reviewed and merged against.

start_head.description: The head before the steward ran.

head.description: The head after the steward ran: the last kept fix, or the start.

subject.description: The base commit, verification profile, finding ID or comment ID.

by.description: The reviewer and model that proposed the fix.

summary.description: What the fix changed, or why nothing was kept.

undo.description: The command that undoes a kept step.

review_id.description: The review of the final head.

pushed.description: Whether the kept fixes were pushed to the pull request.
